test: cypress/e2e/tasks.cy.js > Tasks > completing a task updates the counter
observed: Fails in about half of the runs. After clicking the checkbox of the first task the test reads the 'open tasks' counter inside a .then() callback and compares it with the count it read before. The failing attempt reads the old value. The UI updates the counter after the PATCH request returns (about 100 to 600 ms).
